---

## Language

C++

---

## Explanation

For example
s = "adefaddaccc"

The valid intervals include:

e      [2,2]
f      [3,3]
adefadda [0,7]
ccc    [8,10]

Greedy by earliest ending gives:

"e"
"f"
"ccc"

so:

vector<string>

is returned.
